name: anchor: cursor searches — products, users, roles, keys
description: Copy of "anchor: cursor searches — products, users, roles, keys" that sends resource_type when it creates a role or permission. It replaces the original once ADR-0022 PR 1 is deployed. Cursor walks (limit 2): three products with one name (filtered by that name; default created_at order and sort_by name, all tie), and in a throwaway product three product users, roles, product API keys and resource permissions, the built-in permission catalog (walked to its end against a reference page), and three platform invitations to per-run example.com addresses. Each walk must return the reference page's rows in order, once each, with next_cursor until the last page. Products assert the 400 INVALID_CURSOR refusals. Platform users are only read (creating one means registering an account): the tenant's users walked one per page. Products and invitations are deleted (always) and verified gone.
